title: THE SHIVERING LEAGUE // THE WHITE WALKERS PLAY DEFENSE
narrative: Beyond the Wall in the Lands of Always Winter, Craster's ninety-nine blue-eyed sons lace up ice skate blades made of enchanted crystal dragonglass. 'Alright team!' the Night King rasps in screeching ice dialect. 'The Wall is our penalty box! We run a 1-3-1 neutral zone trap! We didn't march south to murder humanity—we marched south because the Stanley Cup hasn't been contested in eight thousand years!'
